newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate bonds off, spreads tighten a touch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate bonds off, spreads tighten a touch.

text.p: U.S. high-grade corporate bonds were trading off at midday in line with U.S. Treasuries as spreads are seen a touch tighter, dealers said.
"Corporates are tracking government's lower and spreads seem to be a little tighter but not a whole lot of action overall," said one high-grade trader.
Dealers attributed tighter spreads to the market's selloff.
"With the market selling off spreads were pressured to tighten a bit," another trader said.
In secondary new issues, Nationsbank's 7.00 percent five-year issue was trading at 41 basis points over Treasuries after pricing at a spread of 43 basis points, traders said.
In the primary market Thursday, Philip Morris priced $650 million in A2/A-rated five-year notes to yield 7.33 percent or 67 basis points over Treasuries via lead manager Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
Also, Sygnet Wireless Inc priced $110 million in 10-year senior notes to yield 11.50 percent.
In Wednesday's business, a little over $3.0 billion in straight corporate debt priced in the corporate bond primary market, dealers said.
Among new secondary junk issues, Speedy Muffler's 10.875 percent 10-year issue was trading above par where it priced, at 101-3/4 bid, 102-1/4 offered.
In addition, Euromax's 11.25 percent debt was also trading above par, where initially priced, at 101-1/4 bid, 101-5/8 offered.
Turning to the high-yield sector, the broader market was trading off 1/4 to 1/2 point; however, Trump debt was a key gainer, dealers said.
Trump Castle 11.75 percent paper was quoted up two points at 101-1/2 bid, 102 offered. Trump Atlantic City 11.25 percent debt also traded up at 97-5/8 bid, 98 offered, traders said.

On Thursday, the New Jersey Casino Control Commission unanimously approved the acquisition of the outstanding equity interest of Trump Castle Associates by a unit of Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc.
Trump Castle Associates is owner an operator of Trump's Castle Casino Resort in Atlantic City.
A meeting of Trump Hotels shareholders to vote on the acquisition, by Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Holdings LP, is scheduled for September 30.
In other issues, Flagstar debt was off 3/4 at 62-1/4 bid, while Renco Metals lost 1/2 a point to trade at 103-3/4 bid, traders said.
In the governemnt market, the 30-year U.S. Treasury bond is trading off 17/32 at 96-5/32 to yield 7.06 percent compared with 7.01 percent at Wednesday's close.
